name.description: The name of this vertex. Authoring translates to {@link FlowGraph.Vertex#name}.

inputs.description:
The from ports for all incoming edges to this vertex, organized by vertex input port name.
key - input port name
value - port on "previous" vertex that feeds into the named input port

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

x.description: Names of ports corresponding to x input.

y.description: Names of ports corresponding to y input.

context.description: Names of ports corresponding to context input.

convertSpec.description: {@link MlConvertSpec} used by callable interface of {@link #interpreter}

isXNestedInput.description: Whether the vertex has nested-input ports for x.

title:
Functional authoring type for {@link MlPipeline.InterpretVertex} that is used for embedding an {@link MlInterpreter}
within an {@link MlPipeline}.
name: MlPipeline.InterpretVertex.Authoring
